# Bundled filter lists

Attribution: **The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/)** and **EasyList China
contributors (https://github.com/easylist/easylistchina)**.

The three .txt files are unmodified source snapshots. Original headers,
authorship, upstream license links, and source declarations are retained.
SOURCES.json records the URLs, retrieval date and SHA256 of each file.

These data files are distributed under **Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike
3.0 Unported**, at our option under the upstream dual-license grant. Their
original license statement is preserved in UPSTREAM-LICENSE.html (from
https://github.com/easylist/easylist.github.io/blob/master/pages/licence.html).
EasyList China's own header refers to this same license grant.

License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/legalcode
Changes: none to the distributed data. Runtime parsing omits unsupported rules;
that is not represented as support for the full upstream rule syntax.

The filter data is separate from the browser's code and from adblock-rust, which
is MPL-2.0. No scriptlet or redirect resource packs are included.
